name: Aniruddh Bhilvare
title: Staff Software Engineer
tagline: I build AI systems that write software — backed by 13 years of shipping backend platforms that stay up.
availability: Open to staff and principal engineering conversations
about: I'm a Staff Software Engineer with 13+ years spent on backend and distributed systems — multi-tenant SaaS platforms, event-driven services on AWS, and cross-platform mobile at scale.

For the past two years my focus has been agentic engineering: designing AI-powered developer tooling, including an "Agentic Software Factory" that generates working applications directly from product requirement documents. The interesting problems there aren't prompt tricks — they're orchestration, evaluation, and knowing which parts of the software lifecycle genuinely benefit from delegation to a model.
Along the way I've led teams of up to 8 engineers and set the standards for system design, clean architecture, and code review.
